Danthelon's Dancing Axe is a Location within Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It is also mentioned by  Jaheira as a safehouse for the Harpers, if she is alive and has been recruited by the player character.
“
Harpers nesting in your cellar tends to scare off business. So if you mean to sling some coin around, only Jaheira will complain.
„
— Entharl Danthelon

Overview

Danthelon's Dancing Axe is an armour and weapon store located in a spacious three-storied building in the north-west of Wyrm's Crossing. It occupies ground and first floors of the building, and a vast cellar beneath the ground level. The cellar is actually a rendezvouz location for the Harpers, of which Danthelon is well aware, providing them not only the room, but cover as well.

The store owner and trader is  Entharl Danthelon. He can be found inside, behind the counter, while two guards, Half-Orc brothers  Somi and  Tairn, patrol the store.

The entrance to the store is on the first floor, which is also the showroom. There are several display cases here, containing uncommon and rare pieces of armour and weapons. The cases are red-outlined but unlocked. Some items displayed in them are same as in Danthelon's stock (e.g.,  Studded Leather Armour +2 and  Hide Armour +2), but are not included in it while trading with him. In the far corner a wicker chest contains several random potions, possibly including  Potions of Superior Healing.

Also, near the entrance the party can steal two  supply packs (on a shelf and inside the wardrobe), and a  Heavy Supply Pack on another shelf - the only such known item in the game.

If spoken to, Entharl Danthelon first tries to play dumb, as if not knowing anything about the "Harpers" or anyone going by the name "Jaheira". However, he quickly relents and gives the player character a  Rusty Key from the back room. Otherwise, the backroom can be accessed from the outside balcony. The balcony, in turn, can be reached by walking through the potions shop above, or climbing up the ladder at X: -5 Y: 152.

The backroom has plenty of various containers inside. All are red-outlined, but it does make sense to rummage about, closing the door upfront. The party can loot several useful items like  Potions of Superior Healing,  Thieves' Tools or  Trap Disarm Toolkits. An open trapdoor with an iron ladder leads downwards to the cellar.

Inside,  Harper Geraldus awaits with three more Harpers, who are quickly revealed as  doppelgangers and must be fought. If  Jaheira is in the party, she immediately recognizes a codeword in Geraldus' speech and tries to alert the party. If left at camp, the player character may try to  read the mind of the false Harper or Geraldus, to catch the enemy off guard. It is advisable to pay attention to where the party is positioned when starting the battle, as there is an  Oil Barrel laying in the middle of the cellar, and all shapeshifters (except their leader  Chelvin) have  Arrows of Fire on them.

After the fight, the cellar can be looted. There are three Heavy Chests (X: -18 Y: 154, X: -19 Y: 136 and X: -26 Y: 141), as well as a  Supply Pack and some Camp Supplies. A  Kill Order from  Orin the Red can be found on  Hemm's body, and  Surveillance Notes written by this pack of doppelgangers can also be found on a table on an inner balcony.

Upon returning from the cellar, the party can speak to Danthelon again. He outrages on the ruckus, but doesn't turn hostile, regardless of the actual way the party entered his cellar. He may be traded with either before or after the fight with false Harpers.

Loot

Notable items obtained in this location, whether looted, purchased, or obtained as a quest reward:

  • Arrow of Fire - 3x (if unused)
  • Breastplate +2
  • Half Plate Armour +2
  • Heavy Supply Pack
  • Hide Armour +2
  • Leather Armour +2
  • Potion of Greater Healing
  • Potion of Superior Healing
  • Scale Mail +2
  • Studded Leather Armour +2
  • Supply Pack - 3x
  • Thieves' Tools
  • Trap Disarm Toolkit

Entharl Danthelon sells:

  • Blightbringer
  • Cloak of Displacement
  • Garb of the Land and Sky
  • Gauntlets of the Warmaster
  • Harmonic Dueller
  • Horns of the Berserker
  • Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves

Notes

  • If the party access the cellar first by lockpicking from back door, there are no fake Harpers inside, and Entharl has no option to speak about them.[verify]
